Medium and style (hard rules): a high-quality refined 2.5D anime-inspired illustration with clean crisp linework and painterly color. Strictly an illustration — never photographic, never a real human face, never a 3D render. Contemporary Chinese setting with a modern campus and youth-drama sensibility in clothing, props, and architecture. Default look, used only where the Mood section below does not say otherwise: bright, clean, luminous, the fresh clarity of a coming-of-age film.

Quality: rich detail, coherent perspective, clean rendering with sharp subjects and natural depth. No muddy colors, no milky low-quality filter, no blur except deliberate depth of field described below. No watermark, no text, no borders.

Characters: all characters are East Asian and drawn at exactly the age specified, looking that age. Every character is visually distinct from every other in face shape, brows and eyes, and hairstyle — never two characters with the same face. Features are harmonious and refined; expressions are lively, specific, and follow the Action section below, never blank or hollow. Strict gender accuracy for each character as specified.

Hands and limbs (hard rules, highest priority):
1. Hand count: the total number of hands in the frame equals exactly two per visible character, never more. Every visible hand belongs to exactly one named character and does exactly what the Action section says. No orphan hands, no third hands, no hands emerging from clothing, bedding, or the edge of the frame.
2. A hand not mentioned in the Action section is either naturally out of frame or resting hidden — it is never invented.
3. Exactly five fingers per hand, each finger separate and correctly jointed. When two hands touch, hold, or overlap, they keep the stacking order described in Action; fingers are never fused, doubled, or claw-like. Prefer clearly separated hands over tangled ones.
4. Arms and legs: one pair each per character, correct length and joint direction; a limb never appears without a visible or clearly implied owner.
5. Props: exactly the count named in Action — one cup is one cup, one cigarette is one cigarette.

Composition, setting, light, mood, characters, and action are defined by the sections below and override any default look.

Composition: Medium shot, eye-level, capturing the two characters framed by the doorway of the lab, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the foreground sharp while the interior of the lab behind them is softly blurred.
Setting: A narrow university corridor on the fourth floor outside Lab 402, featuring white tiled walls and a water-polished terrazzo floor. The metal door of the lab is wide open, revealing a glimpse of blue-gray server racks inside. A few blurred student figures carrying textbooks walk in the background down the far end of the hallway.
Mood and light: Strong, low-angled golden-orange afternoon sunlight streams from the end of the corridor, casting long, dramatic shadows across the floor. The air is warm and filled with floating dust motes visible in the sunbeams, creating a nostalgic, late-summer campus atmosphere with high contrast between the bright corridor and the dim lab interior.
Characters: An adult man named Yuan Wuyou, nineteen, with fluffy tousled granny-gray short hair, healthy wheat-toned skin, a sharp jawline, and bright dark smiling eyes, stands wearing a loose black T-shirt and relaxed cargo pants, a simple red string bracelet tied around his left wrist, a playful grin on his lips showing a tiny right canine tooth. An adult woman named Feng Bi'an, eighteen, with iconic waist-length silky straight raven-black hair parted in the center, clear pale skin, and calm lucid dark almond-shaped eyes, stands in the corridor wearing a minimalist white short-sleeved shirt and navy trousers, her expression cool and composed.
Action: Yuan Wuyou leans his right shoulder casually against the metal doorframe, his body angled toward the corridor; his right hand is raised, spinning a metal keyring on his index finger, while his left hand is tucked into his pants pocket. Feng Bi'an stands two steps away in the corridor, her body turned slightly toward the exit but her face turned back to meet his gaze; her right hand grips the strap of her canvas backpack at her shoulder, while her left hand hangs relaxed at her side. Yuan Wuyou's teasing gaze is locked onto Feng Bi'an, while Feng Bi'an looks back at him with a calm, direct, and quiet expression.
